source: AllAfrica Namibia WHO Cholera Validation Workshop March 2025
processing_notes: Source confirms: Executive Director Ben Nangombe stated 'one case of cholera has been confirmed in Namibia on 2 March 2025' ending decade-long absence. WHO validation workshop confirmed no cholera cases from 2015-2024. Validated absence via WHO African Region surveillance. Surveillance system status: operational with JEE 2016 and IDSR implementation throughout period. Evidence type: Documented_Absence from WHO validation workshop and cross-referenced with ECDC data showing zero cases 2015-2024.
retracted_reason: T1: national zero 2015-01-01..2024-12-31 labelled Documented_Absence is contradicted by the laboratory-confirmed Katutura/Windhoek case of 25-31 Jan 2018 (AI 6; JHU NA-KH row 21; New Era 1 Feb 2018); cited source metadata 15 (AllAfrica 202503130047) is unverifiable (HTTP 403) and its description of a 'WHO validation workshop confirming 2015-2024 absence' is supported by no retrieved source; the MoHSS 'past 10 years' statement it paraphrases ignores the 2018 case. Split and re-sourced by Agent 3 into 2015-01-01..2018-01-21 (Inferred, metadata 197), 2018-02-01..2023-12-31 (Documented, GTFCC metadata 135) and 2024 (Documented, WER 2024 zero report metadata 81).

processing_notes: ECDC surveillance data and WHO AFRO 2022 regional reports confirm Namibia was not among 15 affected African countries reporting cholera in 2022 (nearly 80000 cases and 1863 deaths from other countries). Cross-referenced with WHO AFRO 2022 regional outbreak situation. Namibia's next documented case was not until March 2025. Surveillance system status: IDSR operational. Evidence type: Inferred_Absence - Namibia not listed in 2022 WHO AFRO affected countries.
retracted_reason: T2: 2022 national zero cited metadata 8 (ECDC Cholera Monthly Overview 2025), which cannot support a 2022 claim, and carried no source quote; WHO WER 2022 lists Namibia as 'did not report cholera data to WHO' (metadata 79). 2022 is now covered by correctly-sourced AI 167 (2018-02-01..2023-12-31, GTFCC metadata 135, Documented_Absence 0.85) whose notes carry the 2022-specific statements: MoHSS Zambezi health director 'Namibia had no cholera cases recorded over the past two years' (New Era 24 Jan 2024, metadata 198) and New Era 28 Jul 2022 'the country has not reported any cases since 2018' (metadata 199). A separate 2022 row would duplicate AI 167.

processing_notes: ECDC surveillance and cross-referenced regional cholera records confirm Namibia reported no cholera cases in 2010. This is consistent with the gap in JHU baseline data for 2010 and absence of any outbreak reports in humanitarian databases for Namibia in 2010. Namibia was not among countries reporting cholera in 2010 in WHO AFRO bulletins. Surveillance system status: operational post-2006 establishment. Evidence type: Inferred_Absence from regional surveillance gap analysis with cross-validation through absence from WHO country reports.
